material_news_signals.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
material_news_signals.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

material_news_signals.body_text: jacksonville fla drake maye stood alone on the sunny sideline here by this point in the fourth quarter already benched for tommy devito his hands were on his shoulder pads and he stared into the distance the stadium was mostly empty a 35 6 beatdown by the jaguars in its final stages and maye looked like he wanted to be anywhere else two weeks ago maye played the worst game of his nfl career in the season opener a super bowl rematch that fell flat again now before october has even arrived maye was left to reflect on another new low and a new worst game this one thanks to two interceptions and two fumbles would feel like rock bottom except it 39 s not clear how things are going to get better the patriots head to buffalo next week wide receiver a j brown is out at least a couple more weeks injuries are piling up on the offensive line they can 39 t run the ball and now the player who was the patriots 39 biggest source of optimism is suddenly their biggest concern 34 just unacceptable 34 maye called sunday 39 s performance when it an old fashioned butt whipping as safety kevin byard described it was finally over maye jogged off the field just around the corner and out of sight from lurking cameras patriots coach mike vrabel was waiting he gave maye a pat on the chest but maye didn 39 t break stride on his way into the locker room when he finally re emerged maye shook his head in disbelief at where the patriots are not just 1 2 which would 39 ve been fine after a tough open to the schedule but playing like a team without answers 34 ball starts rolling like that and we can 39 t get out of our own way i can 39 t get out of my own way 34 maye said 34 i 39 ve got to look at myself in the mirror 34 there 39 s so much that seems wrong with maye right now and so few answers for how it 39 ll get better but it seems important to start here maye 39 s confidence seems shot a year ago when vrabel inherited a mess of a situation one of the most important things he did was re instill a belief within his young quarterback he talked about maye 39 s strengths he stressed the importance of celebrating with teammates and talked to maye about how to lead a football team maye went on to be the league 39 s mvp runner up to los angeles rams quarterback matthew stafford now that seems like a distant memory maye doesn 39 t look anything like the quarterback of a year ago who totaled 31 touchdowns to eight interceptions this season he 39 s thrown for one score and been picked off six times his swagger is gone a year ago in the afc championship game maye didn 39 t tell any of his teammates his plan in the huddle when he bolted on a third down naked bootleg to send the patriots to the super bowl now that same quarterback is floating easily intercepted passes in the final seconds of the first half off his back foot to a 5 foot 10 wide receiver leaving the patriots 39 sideline befuddled after travis hunter 39 s pick and somehow that wasn 39 t even maye 39 s craziest turnover sunday at one point he reached back to throw the kind of deep ball that was so often caught last season and the ball almost comically coughed out of his hands he said that was partly because center jared wilson had a cut on his finger and blood was on the ball and maybe that was why it slipped out 34 you could say that but at the same time i 39 ve got to hold onto the football 34 maye said a slow start from maye would 39 ve been totally understandable some level of regression was expected but it was never supposed to look like this it was never supposed to get to the point where the patriots weren 39 t just losing but losing because of maye and what makes things tougher is it 39 s not clear how this gets better the patriots need a deep threat maye was arguably the league 39 s best deep ball passer a year ago the thought was that adding brown would force defenses to play back against the pats and open things up underneath but they traded their best deep threat wide receiver kayshon boutte just before the season because they felt they didn 39 t need him with brown in the fold then brown suffered an ankle injury in the first game and will be out at least two more weeks without him the patriots don 39 t have any answers mack hollins who picked up a taunting penalty while his team trailed 28 3 is playing like the team 39 s best wide receiver which is great for hollins but not a great sign for the team romeo doubs isn 39 t playing like a 17 million player kyle williams was blanketed in coverage on what ended up as maye 39 s second interception and the offense remains totally unable to run the ball so if it 39 s going to get better it 39 s likely going to have to be maye pulling himself and the patriots out of this mess but that seems awfully difficult considering his decision making of late has resulted in seven turnovers through three games 34 we haven 39 t made good decisions with the football 34 vrabel said maye isn 39 t in the same territory as mac jones was at the end of his patriots tenure but this game felt a bit like the one in germany in 2023 when every time jones dropped back it felt like a mistake was around the corner and what a shocking place that is for maye after last year to be fumbling from a clean pocket to be handing the other team easy interceptions at crucial moments to suddenly have questions about whether last year was a mirage and whether maye really is the guy afterward they all said the right things maye took ownership teammates backed their quarterback vrabel vowed that he 39 d work extra hard to improve the team but alarm bells have sounded maye 39 s slump isn 39 t a blip his struggles are obvious and concern is mounting surely you 39 d think this is rock bottom but then you remember the injuries are piling up and brown is still out and maye hasn 39 t offered any signs a turnaround is near oh and a trip to buffalo is up next this article originally material_news_signals.description: Washington Commanders general manager Adam Peters took an optimistic stance on Jayden Daniels’ recovery from his latest elbow injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: the commanders took an optimistic stance friday on jayden daniels recovery from his latest elbow injury as of right now surgery is not on the table and we haven t discussed injured reserve general manager adam peters said friday morning on the sports junkies on 106 7 the fan radio so it s just a matter of how we re going to get him back on the field that s still to be determined the most notable part of peters comment was that washington doesn t view ir as an option right now meaning the club expects the quarterback back sooner than a four week absence that would be required if he goes on ir coach dan quinn confirmed later friday that daniels will not be placed on ir as peters indicated the former offensive rookie of the year is considered week to week after undergoing imaging and consulting with multiple specialists about the injury to gain clarity on the extent of his absence like most things when you want to wait it out you go through the what ifs in your head and sometimes those are worse than the actual news quinn said what a great bit of news for him and for us daniels went down at the end of the first half of sunday s loss to dallas after a lineman stepped on him the qb tried to brace his fall with his non throwing arm which bent awkwardly daniels was later diagnosed with a dislocated elbow last year daniels season was also knocked off kilter and eventually ended by injuries to the same elbow peters comments don t provide a clear timeline for daniels returning to the field quinn said on monday that the expectation is marcus mariota will start sunday against seattle however with daniels not expected to land on ir there is a shot the qb returns in the next few weeks washington plays indianapolis in london in week 4 hosts the new york giants in week 5 and travels to san francisco to face the 49ers in prime time in week 6 before a bye

material_news_signals.body_text: jacksonville fla drake maye stood alone on the sunny sideline here by this point in the fourth quarter already benched for tommy devito his hands were on his shoulder pads and he stared into the distance the stadium was mostly empty a 35 6 beatdown by the jaguars in its final stages and maye looked like he wanted to be anywhere else two weeks ago maye played the worst game of his nfl career in the season opener a super bowl rematch that fell flat again now before october has even arrived maye was left to reflect on another new low and a new worst game this one thanks to two interceptions and two fumbles would feel like rock bottom except it 39 s not clear how things are going to get better the patriots head to buffalo next week wide receiver a j brown is out at least a couple more weeks injuries are piling up on the offensive line they can 39 t run the ball and now the player who was the patriots 39 biggest source of optimism is suddenly their biggest concern 34 just unacceptable 34 maye called sunday 39 s performance when it an old fashioned butt whipping as safety kevin byard described it was finally over maye jogged off the field just around the corner and out of sight from lurking cameras patriots coach mike vrabel was waiting he gave maye a pat on the chest but maye didn 39 t break stride on his way into the locker room when he finally re emerged maye shook his head in disbelief at where the patriots are not just 1 2 which would 39 ve been fine after a tough open to the schedule but playing like a team without answers 34 ball starts rolling like that and we can 39 t get out of our own way i can 39 t get out of my own way 34 maye said 34 i 39 ve got to look at myself in the mirror 34 there 39 s so much that seems wrong with maye right now and so few answers for how it 39 ll get better but it seems important to start here maye 39 s confidence seems shot a year ago when vrabel inherited a mess of a situation one of the most important things he did was re instill a belief within his young quarterback he talked about maye 39 s strengths he stressed the importance of celebrating with teammates and talked to maye about how to lead a football team maye went on to be the league 39 s mvp runner up to los angeles rams quarterback matthew stafford now that seems like a distant memory maye doesn 39 t look anything like the quarterback of a year ago who totaled 31 touchdowns to eight interceptions this season he 39 s thrown for one score and been picked off six times his swagger is gone a year ago in the afc championship game maye didn 39 t tell any of his teammates his plan in the huddle when he bolted on a third down naked bootleg to send the patriots to the super bowl now that same quarterback is floating easily intercepted passes in the final seconds of the first half off his back foot to a 5 foot 10 wide receiver leaving the patriots 39 sideline befuddled after travis hunter 39 s pick and somehow that wasn 39 t even maye 39 s craziest turnover sunday at one point he reached back to throw the kind of deep ball that was so often caught last season and the ball almost comically coughed out of his hands he said that was partly because center jared wilson had a cut on his finger and blood was on the ball and maybe that was why it slipped out 34 you could say that but at the same time i 39 ve got to hold onto the football 34 maye said a slow start from maye would 39 ve been totally understandable some level of regression was expected but it was never supposed to look like this it was never supposed to get to the point where the patriots weren 39 t just losing but losing because of maye and what makes things tougher is it 39 s not clear how this gets better the patriots need a deep threat maye was arguably the league 39 s best deep ball passer a year ago the thought was that adding brown would force defenses to play back against the pats and open things up underneath but they traded their best deep threat wide receiver kayshon boutte just before the season because they felt they didn 39 t need him with brown in the fold then brown suffered an ankle injury in the first game and will be out at least two more weeks without him the patriots don 39 t have any answers mack hollins who picked up a taunting penalty while his team trailed 28 3 is playing like the team 39 s best wide receiver which is great for hollins but not a great sign for the team romeo doubs isn 39 t playing like a 17 million player kyle williams was blanketed in coverage on what ended up as maye 39 s second interception and the offense remains totally unable to run the ball so if it 39 s going to get better it 39 s likely going to have to be maye pulling himself and the patriots out of this mess but that seems awfully difficult considering his decision making of late has resulted in seven turnovers through three games 34 we haven 39 t made good decisions with the football 34 vrabel said maye isn 39 t in the same territory as mac jones was at the end of his patriots tenure but this game felt a bit like the one in germany in 2023 when every time jones dropped back it felt like a mistake was around the corner and what a shocking place that is for maye after last year to be fumbling from a clean pocket to be handing the other team easy interceptions at crucial moments to suddenly have questions about whether last year was a mirage and whether maye really is the guy afterward they all said the right things maye took ownership teammates backed their quarterback vrabel vowed that he 39 d work extra hard to improve the team but alarm bells have sounded maye 39 s slump isn 39 t a blip his struggles are obvious and concern is mounting surely you 39 d think this is rock bottom but then you remember the injuries are piling up and brown is still out and maye hasn 39 t offered any signs a turnaround is near oh and a trip to buffalo is up next this article originally material_news_signals.body_text: east rutherford n j it didn 39 t matter how well or how poorly jameis winston played sunday in the new york giants 39 12 7 win over the tennessee titans coach john harbaugh said in the aftermath with jaxson dart on injured reserve winston is the giants 39 starting quarterback how he played sunday was immaterial 34 the plans are the plans 34 harbaugh said before he was asked directly if he expects winston to start the giants 39 week 4 game against the arizona cardinals 34 yes yes i do 34 while harbaugh left little ambiguity about winston 39 s immediate future at quarterback there remains plenty of ambiguity about the giants 39 future quarterback depth chart last week harbaugh said 34 all options 34 were on the table in terms of adding to that depth chart reports surfaced this week that the giants 2 1 were exploring adding at least one if not two quarterbacks to their roster which also includes veteran jake haener who served as winston 39 s top backup sunday the caliber of the quarterbacks and how the giants might acquire them remains to be seen but one report suggested that winston 39 s performance sunday against the titans might help determine how hard the giants wind up pushing to acquire another veteran signal caller if that proves to be true the giants may push pretty hard while winston and the giants escaped metlife stadium with a win their performance against the lowly titans left plenty to be desired winston finished 14 of 22 passing for 118 yards failing to lead the giants into the end zone for the second straight week the giants 238 yards of offense were actually outgained by the titans 262 yards on sunday 34 i thought jameis did what was required in this game 34 harbaugh said 34 the first thing you have to do is what 39 s necessary what 39 s required after that then you can do what 39 s possible then maybe the impossible becomes possible that 39 s from st francis of assisi in case you were wondering i thought winston did what was required he did what was necessary 34 to be fair to winston and both offenses frankly it was a nasty day in the meadowlands thanks to a swirling nor 39 easter it rained throughout much of sunday 39 s game and the whipping winds made it tough to throw and forced both teams to put a big emphasis on trying to get their ground games going the giants found some success there tallying 138 rushing yards on 33 attempts but they could never convert that success into touchdowns the giants 39 two trips to the red zone ended in field goals as penalties and or poor execution torpedoed their efforts instead they were forced to turn to rookie kicker dominic zvada 4 of 4 on field goals to do all of their scoring but winston whose giveth and taketh play style can be entertaining but also problematic did not turn the ball over sunday a big emphasis when it came to game planning winston also added a 15 yard scramble on the team 39 s opening drive of the second half which helped extend the drive that ended in a field goal as winston said he was just happy to have 34 enough wheels to get an explosive run 34 for a while it didn 39 t seem like the giants 39 offense would need more than the first three points it scored but the titans eventually sorted their own offensive issues and scored a fourth quarter touchdown before marching down the field in the game 39 s final minutes with a chance to seize a late lead however nbsp giants safety jevon holland intercepted titans quarterback cam ward in the end zone to seal the win for new york holland 39 s heroics helped the giants avoid a fate previous versions of this team have suffered so many times before it was also felt crucial for a giants team that endured an emotional week and didn 39 t want the bad vibes to snowball that too has happened to previous versions of this team before 34 belief faith there was no doubt on the sideline that it was going to happen 34 winston said after the game 34 obviously we are our brother 39 s keeper winning this game for jaxson twelve points six times two it 39 s for you that 39 s twelve so we found a way to 133 get this 34 while winston had dart 39 s back winston 39 s teammates had his tight end chris manhertz called the pregame reports about the giants 39 quarterback situation 34 white noise 34 34 we rally around jameis 34 manhertz said 34 we have his back he obviously is a proven winner in this league as far as his ability to lead players and win games so we 39 re confident in that we 39 re confident in who he is we 39 re confident in his skill set and the coaches do a good job in channeling the offense and the game plan based on what his strengths are 34 running back cam skattebo echoed manhertz 39 s support saying he 39 s not worried about the media or social media or what 39 s going on in the front office 34 my quarterback right now is jameis winston 34 skattebo said 34 that 39 s what i 39 m focused on that 39 s what i 39 m proud of i 39 m proud he 39 s my quarterback and you know i 39 m gonna have his back as long as he 39 s starting in the football game 34 no matter what the giants do at the position moving forward winston said he is going to lock in on the good that game from sunday and that was picking up his first win as the giants 39 starting quarterback after signing with the team during the 2025 offseason and signing a two year extension just a week before this season kicked off 34 every quarterback is really judged off if they won or lost the game 34 winston said 34 i 39 m grateful that i get to be judged off of won not a loss and i 39 ve had games where i 39 ve thrown for 500 yards right and the game didn 39 t turn out the way i wanted it to be and anytime any day i would rather win 34 so no matter what they say or what they do i know it 39 s what 39 s in me not what 39 s on me today we celebrate a w 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can
